Callout.Name: Threats - Protected Witness
Callout.Message: Threatening calls made to a protected address.
Callout.Advisory: Caller using a payphone, witness at home.

Script.Line: It is the same voice every time. Calm. He does not shout.
He knows the name of the street. That is what frightens me.
I want it written down. Somebody needs to write it down.

Lines.Approach: Two calls this week to a number nobody should have. The number is the lead.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
